title: quantbox run manifest (run@1)
description: The machine-readable record of one run: <run_dir>/run_manifest.json, also what `quantbox run --json` prints. VERSIONING: `schema` names the MAJOR version and readers check it. Adding a field is a MINOR change: it keeps `quantbox/run@1`, bumps `x-schema-minor` here and is safe for every run@1 reader (unknown keys are allowed). Renaming a field, removing one, or changing what one MEANS is a MAJOR change: it ships as `quantbox/run@2`. Paths under `files` are relative to the run directory.

sha256.description: sha256 of the resolved config (sorted-key JSON).

commit.description: git sha of the working tree the run was launched from; null outside a repo.

engine.description: The backtest engine that simulated the book; null for runs that simulate nothing (trading, allocation).

sha256.description: Content hash of the data the run read, when the runner can know it.

source.description: lock: loaded by name at the build pinned in datasets.lock; inline: paths or a plugin named in the config.

modelled.description: true only when the engine charged a funding series.

lag_bars.description: 0 in a same-bar RESEARCH run granted by execution.same_bar (ADR-0006, minor 2), and in manifests written before ADR-0005; a bare 0 is refused

same_bar_reason.description: Why the config granted the same-bar override (execution.same_bar.reason, ADR-0006). Present exactly when the run was same-bar under the override (minor 2).

run.description: What the result IS (minor 2, ADR-0006). research: a same-bar run under execution.same_bar — it may inform a question and is never presented as a backtest result; backtest: next-bar. Written by every run that records `execution`; absent from manifests written before minor 2.

max_leverage.description: The gross cap applied to the traded book (the default when the config sets none).

financing.description: What borrowed and idle cash cost (minor 3, ADR-0007): venue.financing as resolved; null when the config declares none. Absent from manifests written before minor 3.

rate.description: {ticker}: a cash total-return index in the prices, its bar return is the rate; {annual}: a constant annual rate.

data_validation.description: Data-validation summary (minor 3, ADR-0007). The full report, per instrument, is the run's data_validation.json (quantbox/data-validation@1). Absent from manifests written before minor 3.

ffilled_bars.description: Bars inside an instrument's life window with no price: forward-filled, target weight kept.

targeted_outside_window_bars.description: Instrument-bars where the traded book targeted a non-zero weight outside the instrument's life window (before its first or after its last price): forced to 0.

overlays.description: The overlay chain the pipeline applied to the decided weights, in order (minor 1). The traded_weights file is the book AFTER this chain, the venue/risk transforms and the execution lag. Absent from runs whose pipeline applies no overlays.

n_trials.description: How many configurations were tried to reach this one; null when unknown.

allOf.description: A same-bar override (same_bar_reason) is a research run, and says so.
A research run is same-bar with a recorded reason (the next entry: a backtest is never same-bar).
